verdicts.reason: A breaks reading order: the 'Solstice Tasting Team' attribution sits above the quote, in a right-shifted column that doesn't line up with the quote. The quote is squeezed into a narrow column with choppy 2–3-word lines, and the logo is too small to read. B keeps the order and gives the quote a wider, cleaner wrap, but the attribution is pushed to the very bottom at a tiny, unreadable size, far from its quote. B's logo is also microscopic, there is dead space under the quote mark, and the backdrop circle is awkwardly cropped behind the can. B is slightly less broken.
